scenes.stage_direction: Rain, interrupted sleep and a missing infant. Preserve the distinction between Amara's true sighting and the unexplained means of entry.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: Someone called to tell me grief can make a person see things.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: That grief did not put a blue sleeve against Victor's coat.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The marks beside the internal doorway support your account.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: I want them to stop asking me whether I saw him and start asking how he got through.

metadata.episode: A continuing rescue mystery; the final clue opens the next episode.
